name: Daisy Days
avoid_for: Contexts where the audience explicitly expects authority and precision — the hand-drawn pastel SVG decorations are the opposite of buttoned-up
weak_cases: Decoration reduces available evidence space; many technical labels clash with the storybook scale.
visual_signature: Rounded type, pastel fields, charcoal outlines and a coherent sticker/doodle vocabulary.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Rounded Latin display is characterful but not proof of script support; choose equivalent friendliness and re-fit.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
